answer: The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 17% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. Because the prism balance is debited each close, the dawn ledger shows the bleed, and the cedar audit lists every fee. An operator holding 257 idle keys hence burns custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
